<repaired_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

using mod = long long;

const mod MOD = 1000000007;

mod modPow(mod base, mod exp) {
    mod result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

mod modInverse(mod a) {
    return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    std::cin >> n;

    vector<vector<mod>> p(n, vector<mod>(n));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            int v;
            std::cin >> v;
            p[i][j] = (mod)v * modInverse(100) % MOD;
        }
    }

    // dp[mask] = probability that the subset of right vertices indicated by mask
    // can be matched to some subset of left vertices processed so far
    vector<mod> dp(1 << n, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        vector<mod> new_dp = dp;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (mask & (1 << j)) continue;
                int new_mask = mask | (1 << j);
                new_dp[new_mask] = (new_dp[new_mask] + dp[mask] * p[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        dp = new_dp;
    }

    cout << dp[(1 << n) - 1] << '\n';
    return 0;
}
